messages:
elaine: heads-up: found an odd embedding length mismatch in the unified-rerank sample app while testing SDK parity. looks like pad/replay during auth-refresh produced a 1535-length vector against a 1536 model.

elaine: repro steps: enable devex batch helper (v0.4.0-beta), send 5 items where helper pads to 6, forcibly expire token mid-flight to trigger refresh+retry.

elaine: Go sample request (trimmed):
```go
client.Embeddings.Create(ctx, EmbeddingsRequest{
  Model: "rwr-1536",
  Input: []string{"doc1","doc2","doc3","doc4","doc5"},
})
```

elaine: observed response payload snippet:
```json
{"data":[{"embedding":[...1536 floats...]},{"embedding":[...1536...]},{"embedding":[...1536...]},{"embedding":[...1536...]},{"embedding":[...1536...]},{"embedding":[...1535 floats...]}]}
```

elaine: interestingly python/sdk-sample (same helper lib) didn't exhibit it in my run; python strips pads early. go helper defers marking pads until batch commit, so replay loses the pad flag sometimes.

vik: that points to mutable batch metadata not being cloned for retries. when auth refresh triggers, the request is reconstructed from a queue entry that has pad_index mutated to -1 after construction.

omar: could also be a server-side race: if server drops pad rows but a retry bundle includes stale padded indexes, response assembly might attempt to map outputs to original positions and hit a short vector. did you get request_ids?

elaine: yes logs include req_id: req-0x9f23. server responded 200 with data array length 6 but last vector short. no 4xx except the initial 401 during token expiry.

kevin: immediate mitigations: (1) SDK should include embedding_dim in response metadata so clients validate lengths; (2) batch helper should deep-copy metadata into the retry record; (3) sample-app should fail-fast on vector length mismatch and surface a clear error to users.

elaine: filed issue DE-4877: "pad metadata lost on auth-retry -> short embedding in go helper" and attached logs + minimal repro.

vik: I'll push a tiny fix to go helper to snapshot pad flags when enqueuing for send. also adding an assertion post-response: if len(embedding) != expectedDim -> raise EmbeddingShapeError with context (request_id, pad_index).

omar: server side: i'll ask eng-runtime to add top-level field "embedding_dim" and include per-item "source_index" to make reassembly robust. even if ordering shifts on retries we can remap reliably. cc @eng-runtime.

kevin: tests: add CI scenario that expires token at configurable byte offset so we exercise the retry path. matrix: go/python x batch_size(2..8) x pad_pos(start/mid/end). expected: no short vectors and no silent reassembly.

devex-bot: created issue DE-4877 and linked PR template.

elaine: thanks. once vik posts a patch i'll try canary on sample-app and share results. aiming to roll a non-breaking patch this week (validate+fail fast, then follow-up with server metadata).

vik: patch incoming in ~30min. will include unit test and changelog note about behavior: "pad flags are snapshotted at enqueue to ensure retries preserve batch shape".

omar: noted requirement for server change: embedding_dim in 200 response + request_id echoed in body. that will help cross-SDK parity checks.

elaine: perfect. appreciate the quick turnaround.
